metric: Braun-Blanquet all-point index; ordinal abundance index, not percent cover
interpretation: Braun-Blanquet all-point condition independently reproduces the frequency-memory pattern: previous-year quantitative state is informative beyond persistent site identity, whereas older history does not provide a robust increment beyond lag-1.
claim_boundary: Post-hoc replication across a second quantitative state variable.
Braun-Blanquet is an ordinal abundance index and is not interpreted as percent cover.
The analysis conditions on recorded Thalassia presence in both source and target years.
No environmental or demographic mechanism is inferred.
